analysis.summary: Today's tech and business headlines highlight several significant trends. In the cybersecurity realm, Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) suffered a costly cyber attack, marking it as the most expensive in UK history. Meanwhile, OpenAI, creator of ChatGPT, has launched a browser to compete with Google. The tech sector also sees advancements in AI, with Netflix investing heavily in generative AI and LangChain, an open-source startup, reaching a $1.25 billion valuation. Business news includes inflation concerns in the UK, with food prices slowing down but overall inflation remaining at 3.8%. Eurostar ordered its first double-decker trains, while economic tensions persist as countries consider their reliance on US big tech following an AWS outage. In entertainment, Netflix is cautiously expanding into interactive experiences.
